title: ProcedureFragment
description: One retrievable evidence unit — a single field's worth of text about a procedure (e.g. just the fee, or just the processing time). This is the unit that lexical/dense retrieval actually ranks (Section 8.3-8.4); field-level accuracy is measured at this granularity, not at the procedure level (Section 12).

fragment_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this fragment, referenced by Evidence.fragment_id and Citation.fragment_id.

procedure_id.description: ID of the ProcedureRecord this fragment belongs to.

section_type.description: Which kind of field this fragment answers. This is the value that must be ranked correctly for field-level retrieval accuracy (Section 9/12).

text.description: The actual evidence text, in Vietnamese, as it will be shown to the grounding/generation step.

source_id.description: ID of the SourceManifest this fragment's text was extracted from.

ordinal.description: Position of this fragment within its source document, for stable ordering and citation locators.

content_hash.description: Hash of this fragment's exact text, used to detect drift and to fingerprint the corpus snapshot (Section 7).

source_locator.description: Pointer back into the source document (e.g. article/clause number) so a citation can be audited against the original text.
